tickets.title: Prepare share-transfer instructions for Moonbadger Arts Center
tickets.text: Prepare approximately $25,000 in share-transfer instructions for Sela Mossbutton’s appreciated Velvet Acorn Growth Fund shares in the joint-taxable account with Jonah Mossbutton. Use verified brokerage-delivery details for the Moonbadger Arts Center youth-workshop fund.
tickets.evidence: asked for agreed 2026-01-23 approximately-$25,000 share-transfer instructions to Moonbadger using verified brokerage-delivery details.
